# Master Test Case Catalog — JubileeVerse.com (incl. Radio)

**Source:** Generated by `qa/build-catalog.js` from radio + site CSVs.
**Total cases:** 459 (170 Radio + 289 Site)

Each test case below is the canonical specification — preconditions, steps, expected result, priority, test type, and current automation coverage.

Use this catalog for:
- Picking which cases to execute in a manual cycle (filter by Priority / TestType / AutomationCoverage)
- Onboarding a new tester (each case is self-contained — read it and execute)
- Audit trail when a regression slips through (find the case, ask why it didn't catch this)

## Automation coverage summary

| Coverage | Count | Percent |
|---|---|---|
| Automated | 135 | 29% |
| Automated (env-gated) | 36 | 8% |
| Partial | 207 | 45% |
| Manual only | 81 | 18% |
| **Total** | **459** | **100%** |

## Radio / Audio playback

| ID | Description | Priority | Type | Coverage | Spec |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-AUDIO-001 | STREAM_ADULT plays | P0 | Functional | Automated | radio.spec.js (5 streams reachable) |
| TC-AUDIO-002 | STREAM_KIDS_35 plays | P1 | Functional | Automated | radio.spec.js (5 streams reachable) |
| TC-AUDIO-003 | STREAM_KIDS_68 plays | P1 | Functional | Automated | radio.spec.js (5 streams reachable) |
| TC-AUDIO-004 | STREAM_GOSPEL plays | P1 | Functional | Automated | radio.spec.js (5 streams reachable) |
| TC-AUDIO-005 | STREAM_CELESTIAL plays | P1 | Functional | Automated | radio.spec.js (5 streams reachable) |
| TC-AUDIO-006 | Switching stations changes the audio source | P1 | Functional | Automated | radio.spec.js (5 streams reachable) |

### Detailed steps

#### TC-AUDIO-001 — STREAM_ADULT plays

- **Priority:** P0 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Automated
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (5 streams reachable)
- **Preconditions:** Adult station tuned
- **Steps:** 1) Tune to a station with streamUrl == STREAM_ADULT. 2) Click play.
- **Expected:** Audio plays. Network tab shows GET to radio.jubileeverse.com/stream/adult.

#### TC-AUDIO-002 — STREAM_KIDS_35 plays

- **Priority:** P1 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Automated
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (5 streams reachable)
- **Preconditions:** Kids 3-5 station tuned
- **Steps:** 1) Tune to streamUrl == STREAM_KIDS_35. 2) Click play.
- **Expected:** Audio plays from /stream/kids-3-5.

#### TC-AUDIO-003 — STREAM_KIDS_68 plays

- **Priority:** P1 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Automated
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (5 streams reachable)
- **Preconditions:** Kids 6-8 station tuned
- **Steps:** 1) Tune to STREAM_KIDS_68 station. 2) Click play.
- **Expected:** Audio plays from /stream/kids-6-8.

#### TC-AUDIO-004 — STREAM_GOSPEL plays

- **Priority:** P1 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Automated
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (5 streams reachable)
- **Preconditions:** Gospel station tuned
- **Steps:** 1) Tune to STREAM_GOSPEL station. 2) Click play.
- **Expected:** Audio plays from /stream/gospel.

#### TC-AUDIO-005 — STREAM_CELESTIAL plays

- **Priority:** P1 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Automated
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (5 streams reachable)
- **Preconditions:** Celestial station tuned
- **Steps:** 1) Tune to STREAM_CELESTIAL station. 2) Click play.
- **Expected:** Audio plays from /stream/celestial.

#### TC-AUDIO-006 — Switching stations changes the audio source

- **Priority:** P1 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Automated
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (5 streams reachable)
- **Preconditions:** Audio playing on station A
- **Steps:** 1) Click play on station B card.
- **Expected:** Audio source switches. Live indicator stays green. Station A loses .playing class B gains it.

### Detailed steps

#### TC-MAP-001 — Map background image loads

- **Priority:** P1 | **Type:** UI | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (zoom controls)
- **Preconditions:** Countries tab
- **Steps:** 1) Click #tabCountries. 2) Inspect .countries-map-bg.
- **Expected:** img element with src /images/WorldMap-Radio.svg?v=2 loaded (no broken image).

#### TC-MAP-002 — 30 dots render

- **Priority:** P1 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (zoom controls)
- **Preconditions:** Countries tab
- **Steps:** 1) Count .country-dot elements.
- **Expected:** Exactly 30 dots.

#### TC-MAP-003 — Dot hover shows tooltip

- **Priority:** P2 | **Type:** UI | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (zoom controls)
- **Preconditions:** Mouse on dot
- **Steps:** 1) Hover over any country dot.
- **Expected:** Tooltip shows country station name HM frequency.

#### TC-MAP-004 — Dot click plays station

- **Priority:** P1 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (zoom controls)
- **Preconditions:** Mouse on dot
- **Steps:** 1) Click any country dot.
- **Expected:** selectStation + playStation fired. Audio starts.

#### TC-MAP-005 — Dots have pulse animation

- **Priority:** P3 | **Type:** UI | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (zoom controls)
- **Preconditions:** Countries tab
- **Steps:** 1) Inspect .country-dot-pulse computed animation.
- **Expected:** animation country-dot-pulse 1.6s infinite.

#### TC-MAP-006 — Dots respect prefers-reduced-motion

- **Priority:** P3 | **Type:** UI | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (zoom controls)
- **Preconditions:** OS reduce-motion enabled
- **Steps:** 1) Enable Reduce Motion in OS. 2) Open Countries tab.
- **Expected:** Pulse and blink animations stop. Dots remain visible at fixed opacity.

#### TC-MAP-007 — Plus button zooms in

- **Priority:** P1 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (zoom controls)
- **Preconditions:** Countries tab
- **Steps:** 1) Click #mapZoomInBtn.
- **Expected:** --map-zoom CSS var increments by 0.25. Canvas widens.

#### TC-MAP-008 — Plus disabled at max (3.0)

- **Priority:** P2 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (zoom controls)
- **Preconditions:** At zoom 3.0
- **Steps:** 1) Click Plus until disabled. 2) Inspect Plus button.
- **Expected:** disabled attribute set. Map at 3x.

#### TC-MAP-009 — Minus button zooms out

- **Priority:** P1 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (zoom controls)
- **Preconditions:** At zoom > 1.0
- **Steps:** 1) Click #mapZoomOutBtn.
- **Expected:** Zoom drops by 0.25.

#### TC-MAP-010 — Minus disabled at min (1.0)

- **Priority:** P2 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (zoom controls)
- **Preconditions:** At zoom 1.0
- **Steps:** 1) Inspect Minus button.
- **Expected:** disabled attribute set.

#### TC-MAP-011 — Restore button returns to 1.0

- **Priority:** P1 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (zoom controls)
- **Preconditions:** Zoomed in
- **Steps:** 1) Zoom to 2.5. 2) Click #mapZoomResetBtn.
- **Expected:** --map-zoom = 1. Canvas back to viewport size. Restore button now disabled.

#### TC-MAP-012 — Viewport scrolls when zoomed

- **Priority:** P1 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (zoom controls)
- **Preconditions:** At zoom > 1.0
- **Steps:** 1) Zoom to 2.0. 2) Drag horizontal scrollbar inside #countriesMapViewport.
- **Expected:** Map pans horizontally. Dots stay anchored to their countries.

## Radio / Default tuned station

| ID | Description | Priority | Type | Coverage | Spec |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-DEFAULT-001 | Jubilee Praise selected on load (no URL param) | P0 | Functional | Partial | radio.spec.js (default station tune) |
| TC-DEFAULT-002 | Audio does not auto-start | P0 | Functional | Partial | radio.spec.js (default station tune) |
| TC-DEFAULT-003 | Deep link overrides default | P1 | Functional | Partial | radio.spec.js (default station tune) |
| TC-DEFAULT-004 | Discover featured banner points to Jubilee Praise | P1 | Functional | Partial | radio.spec.js (default station tune) |

### Detailed steps

#### TC-DEFAULT-001 — Jubilee Praise selected on load (no URL param)

- **Priority:** P0 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (default station tune)
- **Preconditions:** Fresh session no ?station= param
- **Steps:** 1) Open /radio.
- **Expected:** #playerStationName reads Jubilee Praise. #playerStationHm reads HM 305.12. Dial indicator on Jubilee Praise bar. Sidebar Jubilee Praise card has .active.

#### TC-DEFAULT-002 — Audio does not auto-start

- **Priority:** P0 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (default station tune)
- **Preconditions:** Fresh session
- **Steps:** 1) Open /radio. 2) Wait 5s. 3) Inspect HTMLAudioElement.paused.
- **Expected:** audio.paused is true. No outbound stream request in network tab.

#### TC-DEFAULT-003 — Deep link overrides default

- **Priority:** P1 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (default station tune)
- **Preconditions:** ?station=N URL
- **Steps:** 1) Open /radio?station=5.
- **Expected:** Station at index 5 selected (NOT Jubilee Praise). Audio auto-starts (deep link with explicit user intent).

#### TC-DEFAULT-004 — Discover featured banner points to Jubilee Praise

- **Priority:** P1 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (default station tune)
- **Preconditions:** Default landing
- **Steps:** 1) Open /radio. 2) Inspect featured banner eyebrow text and Play Now click target.
- **Expected:** Eyebrow reads Featured · HM 305.12. Click Play Now plays jubilee-praise station.

## Radio / Deploy ops

| ID | Description | Priority | Type | Coverage | Spec |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-DEPLOY-001 | Verify script exits 0 | P1 | Functional | Automated | security.spec.js + api-public.spec.js + manual SSH |

#### TC-DEPLOY-001 — Verify script exits 0

- **Priority:** P1 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Automated
- **Spec:** security.spec.js + api-public.spec.js + manual SSH
- **Preconditions:** radio workspace local
- **Steps:** 1) cd radio workspace. 2) npm run verify.
- **Expected:** All checks PASS. Exit code 0.

#### TC-DEPLOY-002 — Prod URL returns 200 after deploy

- **Priority:** P0 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Automated
- **Spec:** security.spec.js + api-public.spec.js + manual SSH
- **Preconditions:** Post deploy
- **Steps:** 1) Curl https://www.jubileeverse.com/radio.
- **Expected:** HTTP 200 with non-empty body.

#### TC-DEPLOY-003 — Backup file created before sync

- **Priority:** P2 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Automated
- **Spec:** security.spec.js + api-public.spec.js + manual SSH
- **Preconditions:** Post deploy
- **Steps:** 1) SSH ls /var/www/JubileeVerse.com/public/radio.html.bak.* | tail -1.
- **Expected:** Newest backup timestamp matches deploy time.

### Detailed steps

#### TC-DIM-001 — 12 chips render

- **Priority:** P0 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (locked-dims)
- **Preconditions:** Dimensions tab
- **Steps:** 1) Click #tabDimensions. 2) Count chips in #dimensionStrip.
- **Expected:** Exactly 12 chips plus a 13th Reset button.

#### TC-DIM-002 — Music chip is locked and active by default

- **Priority:** P0 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (locked-dims)
- **Preconditions:** Fresh session
- **Steps:** 1) Click #tabDimensions. 2) Inspect Music chip.
- **Expected:** Has .active and .locked classes. + glyph is a dash. Action pill text is Default not Unfollow. cursor: default. aria-disabled=true.

#### TC-DIM-003 — Prayer chip is locked

- **Priority:** P0 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (locked-dims)
- **Preconditions:** Fresh session
- **Steps:** 1) Inspect Prayer chip.
- **Expected:** Has .active and .locked. Action pill reads Default.

#### TC-DIM-004 — Devotionals chip is locked

- **Priority:** P0 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (locked-dims)
- **Preconditions:** Fresh session
- **Steps:** 1) Inspect Devotionals chip.
- **Expected:** Has .active and .locked. Action pill reads Default.

#### TC-DIM-005 — Click on locked Music chip is no-op

- **Priority:** P0 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (locked-dims)
- **Preconditions:** Fresh session
- **Steps:** 1) Click Music chip. 2) Inspect Music chip class list.
- **Expected:** No class change. Music remains active. No state change in localStorage.

#### TC-DIM-006 — Click on Children chip toggles to active

- **Priority:** P1 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (locked-dims)
- **Preconditions:** Children initially inactive
- **Steps:** 1) Click Children chip.
- **Expected:** Children chip gets .active. Action pill text flips from Follow to Unfollow. + glyph flips to dash. Background becomes solid gold #F5C518 with dark text #1b1b1b.

#### TC-DIM-007 — Click on active Children chip toggles off

- **Priority:** P1 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (locked-dims)
- **Preconditions:** Children active
- **Steps:** 1) Click Children chip again.
- **Expected:** Active class removed. Background returns to dark fill. Glyph back to +. Action text Follow.

#### TC-DIM-008 — Reset button restores defaults

- **Priority:** P1 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (locked-dims)
- **Preconditions:** Several non-default chips active
- **Steps:** 1) Activate Children Online Church Sleep & Rest. 2) Click Reset.
- **Expected:** Only Music Prayer Devotionals remain active. The locked three are NEVER deselected.

#### TC-DIM-009 — Active state is persisted across reload

- **Priority:** P1 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (locked-dims)
- **Preconditions:** At least one non-default dim active
- **Steps:** 1) Activate Sleep & Rest. 2) Reload page. 3) Click #tabDimensions.
- **Expected:** Sleep & Rest chip is still .active after reload. localStorage jubileeRadio.activeDimensions.v2 contains its key.

#### TC-DIM-010 — Locked chips re-add themselves on bad localStorage

- **Priority:** P1 | **Type:** Regression | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (locked-dims)
- **Preconditions:** Stale storage entry
- **Steps:** 1) DevTools: localStorage.setItem('jubileeRadio.activeDimensions.v2', JSON.stringify(['mainstream'])). 2) Reload.
- **Expected:** Music Prayer Devotionals are still .active and .locked despite missing from storage.

#### TC-DIM-011 — Dimension count badge matches station count

- **Priority:** P2 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Partial
- **Spec:** radio.spec.js (locked-dims)

## Site / Audio mutex

| ID | Description | Priority | Type | Coverage | Spec |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-MUTEX-001 | Radio playing pauses when TTS starts | P0 | Functional | Manual only | Manual cross-component test on /article.html — jv-media-start CustomEvent is not assertion-friendly in headless audio |
| TC-MUTEX-002 | TTS pauses when radio starts | P0 | Functional | Manual only | Manual cross-component test on /article.html — jv-media-start CustomEvent is not assertion-friendly in headless audio |
| TC-MUTEX-003 | Tap-tap-tap alternation never doubles audio | P1 | Functional | Manual only | Manual cross-component test on /article.html — jv-media-start CustomEvent is not assertion-friendly in headless audio |
| TC-MUTEX-004 | TTS segment transitions keep radio paused | P1 | Functional | Manual only | Manual cross-component test on /article.html — jv-media-start CustomEvent is not assertion-friendly in headless audio |
| TC-MUTEX-005 | Manual TTS pause does not auto-resume radio | P2 | Functional | Manual only | Manual cross-component test on /article.html — jv-media-start CustomEvent is not assertion-friendly in headless audio |
| TC-MUTEX-006 | jv-media-start event signature | P2 | Functional | Manual only | Manual cross-component test on /article.html — jv-media-start CustomEvent is not assertion-friendly in headless audio |

### Detailed steps

#### TC-MUTEX-001 — Radio playing pauses when TTS starts

- **Priority:** P0 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Manual only
- **Spec:** Manual cross-component test on /article.html — jv-media-start CustomEvent is not assertion-friendly in headless audio
- **Preconditions:** Sticky footer playing on /article.html
- **Steps:** 1) Pin radio + click play. 2) Navigate to /article.html. 3) Click sticky-footer play to start radio. 4) Click Read Aloud play.
- **Expected:** Sticky footer's audio pauses (live indicator goes inactive). TTS speaks. Only one audio source playing.

#### TC-MUTEX-002 — TTS pauses when radio starts

- **Priority:** P0 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Manual only
- **Spec:** Manual cross-component test on /article.html — jv-media-start CustomEvent is not assertion-friendly in headless audio
- **Preconditions:** TTS speaking on /article.html
- **Steps:** 1) On /article.html click Read Aloud play. 2) Click sticky-footer play.
- **Expected:** TTS pauses (ttsIsPaused=true word highlight remains play-icon shown on Read Aloud). Sticky radio plays. Only one source.

#### TC-MUTEX-003 — Tap-tap-tap alternation never doubles audio

- **Priority:** P1 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Manual only
- **Spec:** Manual cross-component test on /article.html — jv-media-start CustomEvent is not assertion-friendly in headless audio
- **Preconditions:** On /article.html
- **Steps:** 1) Repeatedly toggle: TTS play -> radio play -> TTS play -> radio play (5 cycles).
- **Expected:** At every moment exactly one source is producing audio. Console may log dispatches but no overlap.

#### TC-MUTEX-004 — TTS segment transitions keep radio paused

- **Priority:** P1 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Manual only
- **Spec:** Manual cross-component test on /article.html — jv-media-start CustomEvent is not assertion-friendly in headless audio
- **Preconditions:** Radio paused TTS speaking
- **Steps:** 1) Start radio + pause via Read Aloud. 2) Wait for TTS to advance through 3+ segments.
- **Expected:** Each segment transition dispatches jv-media-start with source=tts. Radio stays paused throughout.

#### TC-MUTEX-005 — Manual TTS pause does not auto-resume radio

- **Priority:** P2 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Manual only
- **Spec:** Manual cross-component test on /article.html — jv-media-start CustomEvent is not assertion-friendly in headless audio
- **Preconditions:** Radio playing TTS started then user manually paused TTS
- **Steps:** 1) Start radio. 2) Click TTS play (radio pauses). 3) Click TTS pause (TTS pauses).
- **Expected:** Both audio sources paused. Radio does NOT auto-resume — explicit user state preserved.

#### TC-MUTEX-006 — jv-media-start event signature

- **Priority:** P2 | **Type:** Functional | **Coverage:** Manual only
- **Spec:** Manual cross-component test on /article.html — jv-media-start CustomEvent is not assertion-friendly in headless audio
- **Preconditions:** On /article.html
- **Steps:** 1) DevTools console: window.addEventListener('jv-media-start' e => console.log(e.detail)). 2) Click sticky play then TTS play.
- **Expected:** Two events logged: { source: 'radio' } then { source: 'tts' }.
